data.one_liner: Convert Delta format to HTML strings.
data.what_it_does: This lightweight package converts Delta JSON representations into HTML. It supports a variety of elements such as text formatting, links, lists, headers, code blocks, and media.
use_when: You need to convert Delta documents into HTML strings
You are working with flutter_quill content and need to output HTML
avoid_when: You need to parse HTML back into Delta
You require superscript or subscript formatting support
strengths: Supports a wide range of Delta formatting elements
weaknesses: Does not support superscript or subscript elements
Does not support formulas due to delta output issues
